agencyName: Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry (DLI), Construction Codes and Licensing Division
authorityRationale: The literal official reciprocity application form (CC0502, 'Individual Electrical License Reciprocity Application'), listing each reciprocating state with its exact qualifying license class(es) (AJ and/or AM) directly on the form itself — the primary administrative document an applicant actually submits, not a summary page.
reliabilityRationale: The actual application form issued by DLI, containing the per-state class table verbatim — the highest reliability class, matching the Colorado regulation-text and Arkansas rules-PDF precedent.
